intro: Our programmes run on the generosity of partners, donors and volunteers. Here is what helps us reach more children.
volunteerIntro: We welcome mentors who want to invest their time and experience in the next generation.
needsIntro: These are the items that help us run our programmes all year.

needs.title: Programme Space (longer-term need)
needs.text: A space to engage children in training, fun and learning activities.

partnerIntro: Businesses, churches and organisations can support Freedom's Future by providing any of the following:

partnerOptions.title: Venue
partnerOptions.text: Provide or sponsor an event space for the programme.

partnerOptions.title: Decoration
partnerOptions.text: Supply banners, backdrops, balloons and stage décor.

partnerOptions.title: Games and entertainment
partnerOptions.text: Donate or lend sports equipment, musical instruments, face-painting and activity supplies.

partnerOptions.title: Financial assistance
partnerOptions.text: Contribute toward logistics, meals, transportation and outreach items.
